messages.subject: new!  Statistical Rethinking: A Bayesian Course with Examples in R and Stan
parts:
Richard McElreath's new book is out from Chapman-Hall/CRC:

Statistical Rethinking: A Bayesian Course with Examples in R and Stan

http://www.amazon.com/Statistical-Rethinking-Bayesian-Examples-Chapman/dp/1482253445

Without putting words into people's mouths, I can say that
the feeling here at Columbia among those who have read it is very
positive. And it already has two 5-star reviews on Amazon.

If you see (or write!) something like this, please post to the mailing
list or let us know in an email.

- Bob

P.S. I just added a link from the website's documentation page.
I'm about to reorganize the web site doc and include a bunch of
contributed knitr tutorials.
